name: caseledger
description: Collaborative case and evidence tracking with a verifiable audit trail.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names api,web "dotnet watch --project apps/api --urls http://localhost:5150" "npm run dev --prefix apps/web"
scripts.build: dotnet build CaseLedger.slnx && npm run build --prefix apps/web
scripts.test: dotnet test CaseLedger.slnx && npm test --prefix tools/audit-verifier
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run build && npm run test
